message: The other night, I realized my smoke alarm was beeping like it was time for a concert. Instead of groaning about it, I turned it into a little family event. We made popcorn, grabbed some flashlights, and pretended we were on a camping trip in the living room while I changed the batteries. It reminded me that even the little hiccups can be turned into cozy moments together. Have you ever turned a chore into a fun family activity?
